name: FileViewer extension
description:
1. Identified that the FileViewer was rendering `.ts` files as MPEG transport stream video instead of TypeScript source.
2. Created `src/app/shared/file-type.util.ts` with content sniffing (magic numbers) via `resolveViewMode`, keeping media preview only for standard formats.
3. Rewrote `src/app/components/FileViewer.vue` to use `resolveViewMode(fileName, sample)` with content-first detection and text fallback.
4. Added loading/error states, blob object-URL lifecycle handling, and a header badge showing the detected mode and language.
5. `.ts` now renders as TypeScript unless three `0x47` sync bytes at 188-byte intervals prove it's a real transport stream.

request.title: FileViewer media detection
request.content:
FileViewer must resolve its preview mode from **content**, not just extension: shared helper `src/app/shared/file-type.util.ts` exposes `resolveViewMode(fileName, sample)`, `sniffMediaKind`, `readSampleFromBlob`, `readSampleFromUrl` (+ `MEDIA_MIME_TYPES`, `getExtension`).

Rule: images/PDF by extension → media only for standard formats (mp4/m4v/mov/webm/ogv, mp3/wav/ogg/oga/flac/m4a/aac/opus/weba) → everything else falls back to `text`, keeping the extension for syntax highlighting. `.ts` is TypeScript unless the bytes are a real MPEG transport stream (3 sync bytes `0x47` every 188 bytes).

history.summary:
1. User reported the FileViewer treats the `.ts` extension as a video format (MPEG transport stream) instead of TypeScript.
2. Requested fix: sniff the file content to decide the view mode, falling back to text mode (TypeScript) when it isn't media.
3. Requested keeping audio/video preview only for the most standard, well-known formats (mp4/mov/webm/ogv, mp3/m4a/aac/wav/ogg/flac/opus).
4. I proposed magic-number sniffing (including a 188-byte sync check for real MPEG-TS) with extension-based fallback, and created `src/app/shared/file-type.util.ts`.
5. I noted I couldn't access the file tree, so the actual wiring into the file viewer component still needs the exact component path.
